knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The worker is not ready until the competent person has approved the PPE and readiness.
Appendix B states that PAPRs should be used when remediating complex mould situations.
Programme, training and fit are the readiness checks the lesson requires before entry.

practicalCriteria: For a fictional crew, the learner completes the readiness check and stops one worker who has no fit record.
The learner matches three described exposures to PPE from a mock plan and identifies the unsuitable option.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: A worker enters a contaminated area without a verified respirator programme, training and fit.
A loose mask is accepted for a major job.
